Inside one session

Conversation, not coursework

One active question at a time. Teaching and feedback break up every check.

Module 1 · Included

What is an LLM?

By the end, a learner can explain an LLM in plain language, choose useful first tasks, and name the habit that makes its output safer to use.

Preferred mental modelPattern-based predictor

It builds a response one small piece at a time by recognizing patterns learned from many examples.

Repo-first architecture

One curriculum, many harnesses

The core never assumes a model, chat product, connector, file API, or record system.

ai-academy/progressively disclosed
  • SKILL.mdentry point + router
  • curriculum/lesson sequence
  • checks/formative questions
  • exercises/practice + artifacts
  • rubrics/work grading
  • resources/media + analogies
  • assets/course visuals
  • schemas/portable progress

Consumer flow

  1. 1
    Clone or connect

    Bring the repository into the chosen AI environment.

  2. 2
    Invoke the Academy

    The harness loads SKILL.md and only the next useful file.

  3. 3
    Learn in chat

    Native cards and menus enhance the experience; Markdown preserves it everywhere.

  4. 4
    Carry progress

    A platform-neutral record can move between sessions and hosts.
